summary: Probably John's 2nd cousin 9x removed; ran the Mersereau spy ring for Washington.
bio: Joshua Mersereau (1728-1804), via Jean Sr. -> Joshua (1658) -> Joshua (1696) -> Joshua. Ran the Mersereau spy ring (Staten Island) for Washington; Deputy Commissary of Prisoners; NY Assembly. Brothers Jacob (1730) and John/Johannes (1731) were ring members (2C9R); sons John LaGrange Mersereau (worked behind British lines on Staten Island) and Joshua III were spies (3C8R).
